title: Timelapse Landscape
description: Timelapse landscape interval-samples light and weather over a place so hours play in seconds as clouds and shadows sweep. Geography is the actor, and a person, if present, is a scale mark rather than a racing extra.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Use it when the story is a sky, a desert, a city grid as climate, a ridge that must survive several suns. The camera is locked or on a slow, even move that does not fight the sun's path.
Buildings and rock stay solid. Clouds are the motion.
It is the wrong tool for wardrobe process, a still hero in a smoking crowd, or undercranked acting. If the camera walks the avenue in steps, you wanted a hyperlapse.
If only headlights streak under a stuck sun, you have not shown a landscape day.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Choose interval from the process (clouds faster than a shadow-day, stars slower). Lock off or use a motion-control pan.
Ramp exposure for day-to-night. Keep the sun's arc continuous.
Prompt: Timelapse landscape around [Subject] or their place, clouds and shadows sweeping, hours in seconds.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to show the day turning over a ridge, a square, or a citadel. Do not use it as a crowd recipe with a motionless sky.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Baraka and Koyaanisqatsi are the landscape-and-city interval grammar: clouds, shadows, and human systems at non-human rates. Later nature films inherit the same sun-and-cloud contract.
The still should imply a phase of day, not a morphing mountain.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Write light and weather as the motion. Still: one honest sun angle on stable geology.
Video: Time-lapse of light and weather over the landscape of [Subject]. Shadows sweep, clouds race, architecture holds.
No morphing cliffs, no crowd-only acceleration.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is Fast Motion or Timelapse Human. The tell is racing people under a stuck sun, or mountains that melt.
Fix: hours in seconds, traveling shadows, solid ground, camera stable or slowly authored.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Timelapse Landscape in film?
Timelapse landscape is interval photography of a place so weather, shadows, and sun travel occupy a short passage.
Timelapse Landscape vs Time-Lapse
Time-lapse is the method. Timelapse landscape restricts the subject to geography and climate, not wardrobe or a held pedestrian.
When should I use Timelapse Landscape?
When the day turning is the beat: clouds, shadows, night becoming morning over a stable place.
How do I prompt Timelapse Landscape for AI image or video?
Write hours in seconds, sweeping clouds and shadows, and solid geography. Require the sun to move. Do not only speed a crowd.
